findings.title: The regression test never asserts that the late send was refused
findings.claim: The regression test never asserts that the late send was refused. The catch of rpc::closed_error is silent, and nothing fails if stream_send_empty_frame() succeeds or never throws.

findings.title: Cleanup is skipped if an assertion or exception fires early
findings.claim: Cleanup is skipped if an assertion or exception fires early. release_close is only set at the end, and the cv wait on close_entered is unbounded. A failure before set_value() leaves the parked sink.close() and server_done pending.

findings.title: The test relies on a positional assumption and a reference into a growable vector
findings.claim: The test relies on a positional assumption and a reference into a growable vector. BOOST_REQUIRE_EQUAL(hooks.size(), 2u) is followed by `auto& ... = client_factory.hooks.back()`.

findings.title: The test fixture is large boilerplate in the same file: socket, connected_socket and…
findings.claim: The test fixture is large boilerplate in the same file: socket, connected_socket and data_sink wrappers plus a compressor factory. The compressor's compress() has an odd `data.size ? ... : snd_buf(temporary_buffer())` fallback, and negotiate() has an unused is_server parameter and an abort() overload.

findings.title: The new comment says 'Nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready from here on', but…
findings.claim: The new comment says 'Nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready from here on', but client::enqueue_zero_frame() and suspend_for_testing() still exchange or chain on it. enqueue_zero_frame() guards only on _error, not on _stream_closing.

findings.title: Unbounded waits in the test: close_entered_cv
findings.claim: Unbounded waits in the test: close_entered_cv.wait, sink_closed.get(), server_done.get() have no timeout.

findings.title: Reference into a growable container: stream_send_empty_frame is a reference to hooks
findings.claim: Reference into a growable container: stream_send_empty_frame is a reference to hooks.back() of a std::vector.

findings.title: The 'pass-through' compressor is not pass-through: it wraps lz4_fragmented_compressor…
findings.claim: The 'pass-through' compressor is not pass-through: it wraps lz4_fragmented_compressor and has an odd empty-buffer special case; comment misdescribes it.

findings.title: Test factory uses const_cast to mutate itself in a const negotiate(), leaves is_server…
findings.claim: Test factory uses const_cast to mutate itself in a const negotiate(), leaves is_server unused, and the second negotiate overload is abort().

findings.title: ~90 lines of socket/connected_socket/data_sink forwarding boilerplate are added inline…
findings.claim: ~90 lines of socket/connected_socket/data_sink forwarding boilerplate are added inline in the test (pure middle-man wrappers), tied to the current virtual interface.

findings.title: _stream_closing is a new flag that parallels the existing _sink_closed and…
findings.claim: _stream_closing is a new flag that parallels the existing _sink_closed and _sink_closed_future-not-ready state, with a different guard. send() checks _error and _stream_closing, sink_impl checks sink_closed(), and the write-buffer close is serialized by _sink_closed_future.

findings.title: The new comment says "Nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready from here on: send()…
findings.claim: The new comment says "Nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready from here on: send() is refused, and stop_send_loop() waits for _sink_closed_future." stop_send_loop() does wait on _outgoing_queue_ready.

findings.title: The sink/source close contract is written out three times (doc/rpc-streaming
findings.claim: The sink/source close contract is written out three times (doc/rpc-streaming.md, the sink doxygen, the source doxygen), and the wording differs between them.

findings.title: No test covers the drain half of the fix
findings.claim: No test covers the drain half of the fix. The PR says "stream_close() also waits for _outgoing_queue to drain ... before it closes the buffer".

findings.title: stream_close() now waits on the outgoing queue with no bound before it closes the write…
findings.claim: stream_close() now waits on the outgoing queue with no bound before it closes the write buffer, and this wait is not documented as a latency or cancellation change.

findings.title: The test hard-codes `BOOST_REQUIRE_EQUAL(client_factory
findings.claim: The test hard-codes `BOOST_REQUIRE_EQUAL(client_factory.hooks.size(), 2u)` and takes `hooks.back()`. The comment says the stream connection's hook is the last one.

findings.title: The commits carry Claude Co-Authored-By trailers, and the PR body ends with a 'Generated…
findings.claim: The commits carry Claude Co-Authored-By trailers, and the PR body ends with a 'Generated with Claude Code' line. This violates the user's global rule against Claude/Anthropic attribution in commits and PR descriptions.

findings.title: The new doxygen blocks were added above the old plain '// send data Out
findings.claim: The new doxygen blocks were added above the old plain '// send data Out...' and '// receive data In...' comments, which are now redundant leftovers sitting between the doxygen block and the class.

findings.title: The test has unbounded waits and a fatal-assert failure mode that the comments describe…
findings.claim: The test has unbounded waits and a fatal-assert failure mode that the comments describe as a failed check. close_entered_cv.wait, server_done.get() and release_close have no timeout. The regression is described as 'asserts on the pending batch flush', which aborts the whole test binary instead of failing one test case.

findings.title: The test adds near-copies of existing fixtures: three pass-through wrappers…
findings.claim: The test adds near-copies of existing fixtures: three pass-through wrappers (test_socket_impl, test_connected_socket_impl, test_data_sink_impl) that forward every method of the socket and sink interfaces, and a second compressor fixture that copies the lz4 delegate pattern at rpc_test.cc:1764.

findings.title: The test header comment claims send_empty_frame is 'the one caller that is not guarded…
findings.claim: The test header comment claims send_empty_frame is 'the one caller that is not guarded by sink_closed()'. This is not true: the sink's own eof frame in sink_impl::close() calls con->send() without a sink_closed() guard, and the claim is not checked by any assertion.

findings.title: The doc rewrite now says closing the client aborts any stream still open and also points…
findings.claim: The doc rewrite now says closing the client aborts any stream still open and also points to 'Closing a stream' as the required path. It states a lifecycle guarantee ('stream's connection is shut down only once both halves are closed') that sits next to the code's explicit abort-on-error path, and it drops the original 'aborted if the client is closed before streaming is' phrasing without describing that the abort path skips stream_close() and its guard.

findings.title: stream_close() now waits for _outgoing_queue_ready before closing the write buffer, but…
findings.claim: stream_close() now waits for _outgoing_queue_ready before closing the write buffer, but neither the code comment, the headers, nor doc/rpc-streaming.md says that sink.close() latency now depends on queued frames. The docs also omit that a stuck or slow front entry delays close, and that this wait is not cancellable or time-bounded.

findings.title: The reason _error is not reused is recorded only in the commit message
findings.claim: The reason _error is not reused is recorded only in the commit message. The new _stream_closing comment in rpc.hh says 'see stream_close()', but stream_close() does not explain why a separate flag exists. The rationale is that setting _error would make stop() skip shutdown_input() and make stop_send_loop() call shutdown_output() before the eof marker is delivered.

findings.title: The applicable contribution guide requires commits to be made with DCO sign-off, but…
findings.claim: The applicable contribution guide requires commits to be made with DCO sign-off, but none of the three supplied commit messages contains a Signed-off-by trailer.

findings.title: The stream_close() comment says nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready, although…
findings.claim: The stream_close() comment says nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready, although stop_send_loop() still consumes that future after stream_close() has exchanged it for a ready future.

findings.title: The regression test does not exercise the queue-drain half of the fix: it sends only…
findings.claim: The regression test does not exercise the queue-drain half of the fix: it sends only after _stream_closing is set, rather than arranging an entry accepted before the mark that remains queued when stream_close() starts.

findings.title: The new _stream_closing state overlaps existing sink-closure state but has a separate…
findings.claim: The new _stream_closing state overlaps existing sink-closure state but has a separate writer and separate consumers.

findings.title: The shutdown contract is duplicated across the guide and both sink/source API comments
findings.claim: The shutdown contract is duplicated across the guide and both sink/source API comments.

findings.title: The new sink and source doxygen blocks leave the old plain one-line comments between the…
findings.claim: The new sink and source doxygen blocks leave the old plain one-line comments between the documentation and declarations.

findings.title: The regression-test header says the compressor hook is the one caller not guarded by…
findings.claim: The regression-test header says the compressor hook is the one caller not guarded by sink_closed(), although the sink close path also sends its EOF frame without such a guard.

findings.title: The documentation says the connection is shut down only once both stream halves are…
findings.claim: The documentation says the connection is shut down only once both stream halves are closed, even though the same document says closing the parent client aborts an open stream.

findings.title: The new close path makes completion depend on all previously accepted outgoing queue…
findings.claim: The new close path makes completion depend on all previously accepted outgoing queue work, but the public shutdown documentation does not mention that latency or lack of a local bound.

findings.title: The source comment does not preserve the reason _stream_closing must remain separate…
findings.claim: The source comment does not preserve the reason _stream_closing must remain separate from _error.
